dedupe_keys.name: open repair alliance community electronics repair attempts

description: The Open Repair Alliance publishes harmonised records of repair attempts from community repair organisations around the world. Its October 2025 release contains 305,649 row-level electrical and electronic equipment records through July 2025, plus a separate summary of non-electrical repairs. Partner data follow Open Repair Data Standard version 0.3. The provider offers combined and partner CSV datasets through its website and GitHub, free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Coverage reflects participating repair groups and their logging practices; the earliest common observation date was not established. Volunteer attendance, incomplete fault descriptions and differing reporting effort are limitations for deriving population failure rates. Modellers could estimate repair outcomes or represent reuse choices and service capacity in circular-economy simulations. model-odym is a related material-flow tool requiring separate actor and repair-process components. The article identifies this alliance as a repair-data source. No individual repair records were downloaded, and no claims about nationwide waste reductions were tested.
